_comment: Pinned image digests for reproducible builds. `crewhaus build-image` records here by default after every successful build (opt out with --no-record); the Release workflow's docker-digests job records the pushed ghcr.io/crewhaus/<target> digests for each v* tag. Format: `{ "<target>": { "<tag>": { "sha256": "<digest>", "builtAt": "<iso>" } } }`.
